notes: More realistic fighters. Gloves: real 4 oz MMA gloves (padded knuckles, bare fingers curled into the palm, wide velcro strap) and proper boxing gloves. Shorts are now cloth with a flared hem and side slits, not padded blocks. The six-pack sits right under the chest where it belongs. Moves: arms no longer pass through the body (the elbow swings out the way a real one does, gloves rest against the face instead of sinking in), elbows and shoulders stay inside what a human joint can do, high kicks roll the hips over instead of bending the spine sideways, and clinches and chokes no longer have one fighter's head inside the other's chest.
